# LASystems no-adapter correction — SRC-0284

## Sources

- https://www.lasystems.be/nl/msi-raider-16-max-hx-b2wi-035be
- https://www.lasystems.be/nl/msi-raider-16-max-hx-b2wj-039be
- https://eu-spareparts.msi.com/products/s93-0409590-d04
- https://viadennis.nl/originele%2Badapter/S930409590D04/laptop/OMSI2020SQUARE.html

## Evidence

Both LASystems commercial configuration headings explicitly end in `No Adapter`. This is material: the Raider needs a 400W supply to expose its intended performance. MSI's official compatible Delta 400W part `S93-0409590-D04` is €146.37 including VAT but unavailable; a compatible original replacement is live at €169.95 through ViaDennis.

Therefore the €3495.79 LASystems RTX 5080 plus €162.62 warranty is not a complete usable transaction. With the available original adapter it becomes **€3828.36**. Coolblue's €3699 page explicitly says the charger is included; with the Belgian third year that route is **€3861.62**, only €33.26 more and operationally cleaner. The LASystems RTX 5090 complete split total becomes at least €3964.79 + €162.62 + €169.95 = **€4297.36**, still blocked by CPU conflict.
